Summary
: This is a study in English of building construction (bhavana-nirmana) in Mayamata—an ancient Indian architectural treatise forming part of “Vastuvidya”: a stream of Sanskrit technical literature encompassing village and town planning, temple architecture, and more. This study further provides a detailed examination of the practical applications of Vastu-Vidya as illustrated in Mayamata, which includes aspects like site selection, orientation, and structural arrangements aimed at promoting harmony and prosperity.
